messages:
sara: quick check — can vendor confirm standby partition in apac for midnight canary tomorrow? We need ~8 A100-equivalent slots from 00:00-03:00 PT for canary + smoke. Also question on quota carve: can we carve from dedicated pool or need new burst request? @nina

liam: vendor says apac pool has 12 standby slots but 4 already promised to partner. They can reserve 8 if we sign PO by EOD. sending ETA.

nina: procurement — PO draft ready, need sku list + billing project. sara — can you paste the terraform snippet?

sara: sure, here's minimal tf:

```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "canary" {
  region = "asia-east1"
  instance_type = "a100-80gb"
  capacity = 8
  reserved = true
}
```

akshay: FYI I opened PR: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/492. need 1 reviewer, tagging @jordan

jordan: can review after 16:00 PT. can we shift canary to 01:00 PT to avoid batch overlap?

liam: vendor ok with 01:00 PT. will hold slots until EOD if PO submitted. they need billing project id + contact

nina: billing id = infra-canary-prod, contact = nina@redwood.com. attaching PO terms now

devbot: VendorTicket#7891 created: 'apac-standby-reserve — 8 slots' — https://vendor.example.com/t/7891

sara: thanks — akshay can you keep PR small? if review + PO by EOD we proceed. small heads-up: ops-oncall window 00:30-02:00 PT — @oncall please ack

oncall: ack. i'll monitor logs and set alerts

jordan: moved perf-tests to 02:30 PT

akshay: PR updated with minimal tf and note, ready for review

liam: vendor confirmed hold until 23:59 PT. if no PO they'll release slots

sara: copy. will push today. :thumbsup:
